description: The envelope the forecast sidecar had issued for one market and timeframe by a given time: a MAGNITUDE band (how far price may travel over the next 24 bars, as two prices and a width in ATR), the odds of a move of 0.5, 1 and 2 ATR within 6, 12 and 24 bars, and its measured calibration (ece, n, band coverage). It carries NO direction — there is no side, no median, and the band is symmetric about the last close by construction; say so, and never turn it into 'up' or 'down'. When calibration reads unmeasured or uncalibrated the deck does not draw it and you should say the band is not yet trusted. Facts only, computed in code; nothing here is a recommendation.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the envelope must have been issued by (defaults to now); for a replay, the logical clock

name: forecast
